dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: I'm a doctor. If you have any minor ailments or injuries, I'm your man. As for major ailments and injuries... I'll do what I can, but I'm not making any promises.

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: If you're fatigued from work, you can rest in the infirmary. You can't hear the loudspeaker there, which is good for your mental health.
